question: How many adults with behavioral health conditions smoke?
answer: Individuals with behavioral health conditions account for 38% of all U.S. adult cigarette consumption, despite making up only 25% of the population. This group has a smoking rate of 23%, which is higher than the general adult rate of 14%.
